_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. All fields are optional — CLI flags override these values.

_field_help.dateFrom: Only include messages on/after this date. YYYY-MM-DD or null.
_field_help.dateTo: Only include messages on/before this date (inclusive). YYYY-MM-DD or null.
_field_help.chats: Array of chat names or phone numbers to include. Empty array = ALL chats.
_field_help.downloadMedia: true = download photos/voice/video/docs. false = text only.
_field_help.linkPreviews: Fetch Open Graph previews for links in messages.
_field_help.maxMessagesPerChat: 0 = as many as WhatsApp Web exposes. Otherwise cap per chat.
_field_help.incremental: Only re-fetch chats with new activity since the last run.
_field_help.format: Comma list of extra exports: pdf,json,ndjson,csv,singlefile (html always on).
